extraction.notes: Reconciliation taken from Table 3 (Definitions and Reconciliations, printed p.9), which starts from Net income attributable to common stockholders ($262,044), not the $262,076 net income in Table 1. Core FFO is the only adjusted FFO metric; AVB reports no AFFO, so affo fields are null. Diluted shares printed as 139,976,082 and divided by 1,000 to match thousands units; check: 313,908/139,976 = 2.24 and 316,923/139,976 = 2.26. Sums verified: FFO and Core FFO foot to reported totals. Ambiguous categories: 'Unconsolidated entity (gains) losses, net' coded 'other'; 'Gain on other real estate transactions, net' coded land_sale_gain_loss (nature not stated); condominium lines and income tax expense coded 'other'. Gain on extinguishment of consolidated debt is a dash (none) for Q1 2022 and omitted. recurring_capex_disclosed null because there is no AFFO section and no recurring capex figure in the pages provided. Duplicate Table 3 appears on seq 39 (printed 22, Attachment 11); seq 12 used.
